title: server: protocol-06 §5.7 consent endpoints (inbound + outbound)
description: Decision mimid-1wgh.7.9 (2026-10-18) deferred §5.7 requestConsent/updateConsent 'to a later bead'; no such bead existed. Decision mimid-1wgh.21 says consent endpoints 'are still implemented on the server for interop' but they are not routed (http.rs:32-33). Wire types exist (crates/mimi-protocol/src/consent.rs, decisions .5.16, .5.68, .5.69). Scope: inbound routes per §5.7 with v1 implicit-allow semantics behind the existing consent::allows hook (no enforcement, decision .21), outbound PeerClient methods, directory entries (see mimid-1wgh.6.78). JMAP surface for users to grant/revoke stays with mimid-1wgh.12 (.7.9 rationale). Haven mimi-hubd serves both endpoints on its TLS-PL lane, so the live interop harness (mimid-1wgh.46.1.6) can test it. Plan for Mark's approval before code.
